duty.cafe: go to the Coffee Cup and make coffee for tips.
duty.stand: go to Fig Jr.’s stand and pour lemonade for tips.

wage: wage so far {coins}; days to payday: {days}.
done: the week’s work is done: a full wage. Extra work still earns XP.

nudge.condo: Spinner hasn’t seen you this week. Two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.
nudge.store: Pip hasn’t seen you this week. Two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.
nudge.post: Stamp hasn’t seen you this week. Two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.
nudge.cafe: Bean hasn’t seen you this week. Two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.
nudge.stand: Fig Jr. hasn’t seen you this week. Two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.

fired.condo: Spinner has let you go; ask again and you start from the first rank.
fired.store: Pip has let you go; ask again and you start from the first rank.
fired.post: Stamp let you go after empty weeks; ask again and you start at the first rank.
fired.cafe: Bean has let you go; ask again and you start from the first rank.
fired.stand: Fig Jr. has let you go; ask again and you start from the first rank.

cafeDone: tips add up on the tray as you pour; paid when you leave work.
standDone: tips add up on the tray glass by glass; paid when you leave work.
payslip: go home and open your payslip in your homestead mailbox.

call.sweep: Spinner needs you: litter on the arcade floor. Any time today.
call.fix: Spinner needs you: a cabinet has gone dark. Any time today.
call.restock: Pip needs you: crates for the empty shelves. Any time today.
call.serve: Pip needs you: customers are waiting in the store. Any time today.
call.deliver: Pip needs you: a parcel at the store to deliver. Any time today.

answered: all of today’s tasks are done; more come tomorrow.
tipsAll: today’s tips are all earned; shifts still earn work XP.
